verdict.rationale: Notte documents generating workflow code that can be edited, deployed and rerun as scripts, plus a hybrid mode where deterministic parts are scripted and AI is used only when needed, which it says cuts costs by 50%+. That approximates replaying generated code instead of re-prompting the LLM, but there is no explicit caching of resolved agent actions. missing for 10: an explicit action/code cache or replay mechanism for agent runs, documentation of deterministic replay from a prior LLM-resolved run, latency/cost evidence specific to cached replays, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache resolved actions or generated code so repeat runs replay deterministically at lower cost and latency than re-prompting the LLM

citations.quote: letting you script deterministic parts and use AI only when needed, cutting costs by 50%+ while improving reliability
